classification: preregistered 3x3 parameter-neighborhood robustness check; not a best-parameter search
decision_rule: All P1-P7 pass -> center is classified parameter-robust but remains research/paper-review only. Any failure -> center is classified parameter-fragile and must not be promoted. Do not choose a grid winner after seeing results.

gates.P1_execution: all 15 A/B backtests, all 9 overlay combinations and the 3x full-start stress run complete with non-empty curves
gates.P3_drawdown_plateau: at least 7/9 combinations have full-start 2x MDD >= -25%
gates.P4_return_plateau: at least 7/9 combinations have full-start 2x annual >=5% and Sharpe >=0.55
gates.P5_recent_plateau: at least 7/9 combinations have recent mean return >0 and at least 4/5 positive fresh starts
gates.P6_stress_plateau: at least 7/9 combinations have full-start 3x return >0 and MDD >= -30%
gates.P7_no_leverage: all monthly overlay weights remain within [0,1.0]

grid.selection: center (60,15%) remains the candidate; no grid cell is selected for deployment

known_limitations: Neighborhood checks share the same underlying history and are not independent samples.
R40 is a local research snapshot and canonical data drift remains unresolved.
A parameter plateau cannot remove data-version, industry-PIT, or survivor-bias risks.
